card.title: VIVE LA RESISTANCE!
card.text: Add 2 RESISTANCE cards to the enemy deck. Draw a card.
card.flavorText: The militant arm of the French resistance was called Maquis. These were rural guerilla groups that fought against the Nazi occupation of France and the Vichy government. At first the groups were scattered, but in 1943, a man named Jean Moulin managed to merge them into a single movement called Conseil National de la Resistance (CNR). After Jean Moulin was captured by the Gestapo and tortured to death Henri Giraud and Charles de Gaulle took over control of CNR. The CNR and other resistance groups worked closely with the Allies conducting sabotage, providing intelligence and performing armed resistance operations both before and after the Allied invasion in Normandy.
